inputs.text: Locked-off camera at a real outdoor excavation beside a paved walkway. At the top of the exposed trench wall, slightly weathered small gray concrete blocks form a sidewalk. Below them are thin natural fine sand and compact gray crushed stone, and underneath brown soil with a single small circular hollow gray drainage pipe emerging from the wall. There is a small irregular shadowed void close to the pipe. A few loose grains trickle down the wall into the gap; the pipe and pavers do not deform. Real-scale construction materials, documentary natural light, no labels.
